map.0.5 克拉是多少分/克: How many points per carat is 0.5 carat
: 1 carat = 0.2 g = 100 points; 0.5 carat = 50 points = 0.1 g. The familiar "50-point diamond" is therefore half a carat.
map.：圆钻 1ct 直径约 6.5mm；同重下公主方/椭圆视觉更大，垫形显小，选琢型: : a 1ct round diamond is about 6.5mm across; at the same weight princess and oval look larger while cushion looks smaller, so cut shape also affects face-up size.
map.不。大克拉稀缺，单价随重量指数上升；同等级 1ct 单价远高于 0.9ct，整克: No. Large carats are scarce and price rises exponentially with weight; at the same grade a 1ct stone costs far more than a 0.9ct one — the full carat is a price jump point.
